exposure: patients who underwent conservative surgical treatment before intrauterine balloon tamponade use
cohort: Women who gave birth vaginally at a single site between January 2005 and June 2018 and experienced severe postpartum hemorrhage with medical treatment failure following vaginal delivery.
finding: While there was a nonsignificant overall reduction in emergency peripartum hysterectomy following implementation of intrauterine balloon tamponade, there was a significant decrease in these cases when conservative surgical treatment was followed by intrauterine balloon tamponade.
